provenance: Authored in-repo for Cerebro. Original prose, not derived from third-party skills.

limitations: A probe checks your tests, not your thinking: it cannot tell you whether the invariant you pinned is the right one.
Passing every probe you thought of says nothing about the invariants you did not name.
skills.provenance: Cerebro first-party pack; prose authored in-repo.
skills.summary: Break an invariant on purpose and confirm the test fails, so you know the test protects something rather than merely passing.

limitations: Verification shows what happened once, in one environment; it does not establish stability across platforms, versions or untried inputs.
Running something successfully proves it ran, never that it is correct.
skills.provenance: Cerebro first-party pack; prose authored in-repo.
skills.summary: Execute the claim before stating it, especially numbers, commands and examples destined for documentation.

limitations: Protects only against the values you anticipated.
Costs future flexibility, and the cost is paid by whoever needs the case you closed.
Some constraints genuinely cannot be expressed structurally; forcing it produces worse designs than the checks it replaces.
skills.provenance: Cerebro first-party pack; prose authored in-repo.
skills.summary: Prefer designs where an invalid state cannot be written down over checks that reject it, and know when a check is the honest tool instead.
